clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may sacrifice a land.
If you do, search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.

mapping.notes: Crypt Lurker's optional sacrifice (a land you control), 'If you do' as Conditional(MAY_DONE), Burnished Hart's search (QAtMost(2) basic lands, tapped, then shuffle). Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/springbloom_druid_trades_a_land_for_two_basics_tapped.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/springbloom_druid_no_sacrifice_no_search.json.
